shots.text: The Heart had reached the inner wall when the night split open in the east.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Battle at the inner wall. The eastern horizon tears with a line of white light.

shots.text: He came up the road on foot. The Unbound fell still around him as he passed, the way the dead fall still at the end of a long walk.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A tall figure in glowing white robes walking up the east road through the horde; grey-eyed spirits freeze and fade as he passes. Nyxara turns toward him.

shots.text:
He had walked the road of the dead the whole way round the world. Every light we lost had passed him going the other way.

He had kept them.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Close on the lantern: white flame, six coloured sparks circling inside, the face of a city reflected in each spark.

shots.text: Hello, Ysolde. I'm sorry I'm late. It was a long way round.
shots.speaker: oswin
shots.art_note: Oswin, white-haired, standing tall, at the foot of the wall below the Queen.

shots.text:
He lifted the lantern to the broken frame of the Sunstone.

And the sun came up over Solenne.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Oswin raising the lantern. Light pours up into the empty Sunstone frame above the city; it blazes. Real dawn floods the battlefield. (Game lighting: night to dawn.) Oswin joins as a hero.
